meta.name: alterlab-etetoolkit
meta.description: Manipulate, annotate, and render phylogenetic trees programmatically with the ETE Toolkit (ete3) — parse and edit Newick/NHX, detect duplication/speciation events, infer orthology and paralogy, query NCBI taxonomy, and export PDF/SVG figures. Use when traversing or reformatting tree files, doing phylogenomic comparative analysis, or producing publication tree graphics in Python. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 用 Python 编程处理、注释和渲染系统发育树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Newick/NHX 格式分析进化树并生成出版级图表。
